objects.description: A question put to chosen groups, answered inside a window, with the settings that say how a choice is made.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: question
fields.description: The question the poll asks.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: How a choice is made: exactly one, up to a number, or votes paid for from a credit budget at the square of their count.

fields.name: max_choices
fields.description: The most distinct choices one answer may pick when the mode is up_to.

fields.name: budget
fields.description: The credits each answer may spend when the mode is quadratic.

fields.name: change_allowed
fields.description: Whether an answer may be replaced until the poll closes.

fields.name: per_group
fields.description: One answer per person, or one per person for each of the poll's groups they are in.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.description: The groups the poll goes to. Opaque ids the host owns.

fields.name: opens_at
fields.description: When answers start being taken.

fields.name: closes_at
fields.description: When answers stop being taken.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where the poll is in its life.

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: When the result was published; empty until then.

fields.name: published_by
fields.description: Who published the result, supplied by the mount.

fields.name: published_group_ids
fields.description: The groups the published result is shown to.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Who made the poll, supplied by the mount.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the poll was made.

indexes.name: created
indexes.description: The newest-first ordering every listing uses.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: poll_id
fields.description: The poll the choice belongs to. The address decides, not the body.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What the choice says.

fields.name: position
fields.description: The choice's place in the list, counting from one.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the choice was added.

objects.description: Who answered a poll: enough to stop a second answer and to count turnout, and nothing about what was chosen.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The response id. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: poll_id
fields.description: The poll answered.

fields.name: answered_by
fields.description: Who answered, supplied by the mount. Never read from the request.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the answer was given for when the poll counts per group; empty otherwise.

fields.name: answered_at
fields.description: When the answer was last given.

indexes.name: once
indexes.description: One answer per person, per group when the poll counts per group.

objects.description: What was chosen: the votes placed on each choice, enough to count, and nothing about who answered beyond an optional link to the response.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: poll_id
fields.description: The poll the votes are for.

fields.name: response_id
fields.description: The participation this ballot belongs to, so its owner can read and change it. A secret ballot leaves it empty.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the votes count towards when the poll counts per group; empty otherwise.

fields.name: votes
fields.description: The votes placed on each choice, keyed by choice id.

fields.name: cast_at
fields.description: When the votes were cast.

indexes.name: response
indexes.description: Finding the ballot a response owns.
